label: Loaded data truth
query: How should AbarVa label current Lakeshore loader truth: setup/admin approval-ledger proven or CSV/context-loader backed?
answer:
My read
For Lakeshore Holdings, AbarVa should label the current loader truth as “CSV/context-loader backed,” not “setup/admin approval-ledger proven.” Why
The active Lakeshore 360 substrate explicitly notes that “Loaded-data truth is CSV/context-loader backed; setup/admin approval-ledger proof is not complete.” That means your current state is data-file backed, not governance-ledger certified.
The approval-ledger spine for Lakeshore is only partially wired: Kyriba (LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026) is stage-backed through Strategy → BAFO, but Executive Decision, Selection, Transition, and Value are still in review/needs-review demo states.
AMS modernization (LSH-AMS-MODERNIZATION-2026) is explicitly safe only through Evaluation and must not be presented as BAFO/Decision/Transition/Value complete — another signal that the admin approval-ledger layer isn’t yet a reliable truth source. Decision fork
Conservative/accurate: Label as “CSV/context-loader backed” and only call out specific Source artifacts (like Kyriba) as “stage-backed” where the spine is known to be valid.
Aggressive (not advised yet): Over-label as “approval-ledger proven,” which would blur the distinction between file-loaded data and governance-approved truth. What I would do next
Standardize on “CSV/context-loader backed” as the top-level label for Lakeshore’s current loader truth, and add a sub-tag for Kyriba indicating “Source artifact spine stage-backed through BAFO; decision/transition/value pending.” The remaining gap is wiring and validating the setup/admin approval-ledger so it can legitimately become the “proven” label later.
